item.title: Lilly Triple G and Makary Ouster
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly continues to develop its Triple G (triple gut hormone agonist) program, a potential next-generation obesity and metabolic disease therapy. Separately, the theme covers the ouster of Dr. Marty Makary from a key health policy position, likely tied to shifting regulatory priorities. Triple G targets multiple incretin receptors to maximize weight loss and glycemic control, signaling Lilly's aggressive push in the metabolic space. The personnel change may affect FDA or public health direction.
  • MoAs: Triple G: Agonist at GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors; stimulates insulin secretion, slows gastric emptying, suppresses appetite, and increases energy expenditure.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
